items.title: MARYOS Online Architecture enters RC7
items.body: MARYOS RC7 introduces a dynamic MARYNET site directory, disk cache, safe server-delivered UI applications, external language packs and a staged MARY Update rollback layer.

items.title: MARY Online Services begins testing
items.body: MARY Computer Systems has begun testing MARY Update, online software catalogs and MARYNET information services.

items.title: MARYOS 1.0 ships
items.body: MARYOS 1.0 Build 96.100 is now available for MARY PC systems.
